overview: The Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy is a state-level initiative aimed at promoting industrial development and Industrial Investment Promotion Policy is a state-level scheme designed to attract investment, promote industrial growth, and generate employment in Bihar by offering fiscal incentives, infrastructure support, and land acquisition, and infrastructure development to create a conducive environment for industries. The policy aims to position Bihar as a preferred destination for domestic and international investors by offering a range of fiscal and non-fiscal incentives.
objectives: Attract domestic and foreign direct investment into Bihar
Promote sustainable industrial development and employment generation
Develop world-class industrial infrastructure and logistics
Enhance competitiveness of Bihar-based industries through fiscal incentives
Support MSMEs and ancillary units for inclusive industrial growth
Ensure balanced regional development across all districts of Bihar
Simplify regulatory procedures and ensure single-window clearance
eligibility: Eligible beneficiaries include new industrial units, expansion/diversification of existing units, and mega projects in manufacturing, services, and agro-processing sectors. Units must be registered under the Factories Act, 1948 or Shops and Establishments Act, and obtain necessary clearances from Pollution Control Board and other statutory bodies. Investment in plant and machinery must meet minimum thresholds as specified for different categories of industries.
benefits: Fiscal benefits include capital subsidy, interest subsidy, stamp duty exemption, electricity duty exemption, VAT/GST reimbursement, and employment generation subsidies, and land cost assistance. Non-fiscal benefits comprise single-window clearance, infrastructure support (roads, water, power), skill development assistance, and facilitation for land acquisition. Special incentives are provided for thrust sectors like food processing, textiles, leather, IT/ITES, and renewable energy.
financial_support: Financial support includes capital subsidy up to 30% of fixed capital investment (capped at INR 30 Crore for mega projects), interest subsidy of 5% on term loans for 5 years, and 100% stamp duty exemption. Additional subsidies are available for power tariff, employment generation, and quality certification. Disbursement is made through the State Level Committee after verification of investment and employment generation.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to INR 30 Crore (capital subsidy for mega projects)
application_process: 1. Submit online application via the Udyog Bihar portal (https://udyog.bihar.gov.in). 2. Obtain acknowledgment and project registration number. 3. Submit detailed project report (DPR) along with required documents. 4. Application scrutinized by District Industries Centre (DIC). 5. Forwarded to State Level Committee for approval. 6. Upon approval, submit claim for subsidy with proof of investment and commencement of production. 7. Subsidy disbursed after verification by authorized agency.
required_documents: Memorandum and Articles of Association / Partnership Deed
Sanction letter from bank/financial institution for term loan
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Pollution Control Board
Clearance from Fire Department and other statutory bodies
Details of plant and machinery with quotations
Proof of commencement of commercial production
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications accepted throughout the year as per policy validity
implementing_agency: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar
caveats: Incentives are disbursed only after commencement of commercial production and verification of investment
Units must remain in operation for a minimum period (typically 5 years) to retain benefits
Claims must be submitted within stipulated time after commercial production
Policy benefits are subject to availability is subject to annual budgetary allocations
Ineligible for units that have availed similar benefits under other central or state schemes for the same investment
